main_text.p: lorum Christi consternatio, narrata Matthaeo, XIV.v.26. Hinc Apuleio, in solemni imprecatione, species mortuorum, busstorum formidamina, sepulchrorum terriculamenta.
᾿Αλεγνὸς, infirmus, languidus, iners; a Dzone: nisi quis malit ex σπάναξ, fucus.
᾿Αλεπχὴς, non videns: etiam ἀφανὴς, obscurus, ut Hesychius exponit: Dark.
᾿Αβαχὴς, mutus, taciturnus: (ἀβαχέω, fileo; non habeo quid dicam:) planè ut Angli, cum dicunt, We was very blanck.
᾿Απλοῦς, simplex, sincerus, Dull: Vide infrà, in ἁπλοῦς.

᾿Αληθὴς, verus: ἀληθεία, veritas: true, truetb. Veteribus trtwtan, fidere; & trtwtb, fidelitas: quæ cum etymologia verbi ἀληθὴς, quæ à veteribus Grammaticis traditur, bene conveniunt: quibus ἀληθὴς, quasi ἀλήθης, impavidus. Prodendæ siquidem ut veritatis, ita & fidelitatis inter causas, præcipuus timor.

page.notes: Greek words are printed in Greek letters; the transcription of the Greek is approximate. Several black-letter English words ("Dzone", "Dark", "blanck", "Dull", "tart", "truetb", "trtwtan", "trtwtb") are doubtful and were set in black letter within roman text. Some Greek accents may be inexact.
